description: Source code implementing zlib wrapper functions for error handling, initialization, deflation, and inflation within the git project.

methods.name: zerr_to_string
methods.description: Converts zlib error status codes to human-readable strings.

methods.name: zlib_buf_cap
methods.description: Calculates buffer capacity with a maximum limit of 1GB.

methods.name: zlib_pre_call
methods.description: Prepares zlib stream for compression/decompression calls by copying relevant fields.

methods.name: zlib_post_call
methods.description: Updates stream state after zlib call, checking for consistency and adjusting pointers.

methods.name: git_inflate_init_gzip_only
methods.description: Initializes a zlib inflate stream for gzip only.

methods.name: git_deflate_bound
methods.description: Calculates the maximum size of compressed data.

methods.name: do_git_deflate_init
methods.description: Helper for initializing deflate with specific window bits.

methods.name: git_deflate_init_gzip
methods.description: Initializes deflate stream for gzip compression.

methods.name: git_deflate_init_raw
methods.description: Initializes deflate stream for raw compression.
